title: [BUG] TypeScript SDK ignores `resume` parameter - session resumption not working
author: salvinoarmati

top_comments.author: buremba
top_comments.body: @salvinoarmati were you able to find a workaround? This is currently a blocker for my use-case

top_comments.author: dcalsky
top_comments.body: Although session ids are different between the first and second calls, claude can really continue to work with the previous context.

top_comments.author: iamgajendra
top_comments.body:
@salvinoarmati @buremba I was stuck on the same issue for days.. finally found out the root cause. 
This is not a bug in the sdk or the cli. Session is not suppose to be same between messages.

```
User message 1 -> assistant response (sessionId: 1)
User message 2 -r 1 -> assistant response (sessionId: 2)
User message 3 -r 2 -> assistant response (sessionId: 3) 

```
When you do `-r sessionId` claude-code will resume the session and process your prompt but while responding it will create a new s
